name: Train Window
description: Scenery seen from a moving train: poles and trees whip past, hills drift, mountains barely move, and a tunnel carries you from one view to the next.

props.name: scenes
props.description: The views. Each is drawn on the spot from its seed, so the same seed gives the same country every time, and the mood sets the light and weather.

props.name: speed
props.description: How fast the train runs. Every layer, the motion blur, the snow and the rail jolts follow it together; 0 stops the train.

props.name: index
props.description: The view shown, when you control it. Changing it sends the train through a tunnel to the new view.

props.name: onIndexChange
props.description: Called when the train moves on to the next view by itself (see interval).

props.name: interval
props.description: Milliseconds between tunnels when the view changes by itself. 0 keeps the current view.

props.name: caption
props.description: A short line set on the window sill, such as the line and the kilometre post.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the carriage wall around the window. It is 16:10 and full width by default. Other div props are passed through.
